facts: UsageDimension: immutable dimension key and exact unit
UsageEvent: immutable decimal<6> quantity, point or interval, source identity and ordered optional replacement provenance
UsageCorrection: immutable unique terminal replacement/retraction fact
operations: Usage.correct and Usage.retract with unique terminal facts
Usage.aggregate with exact BigInt sum and contributing immutable IDs
Usage.replay with authorization and dimension validation
invariants: Same tenant/source/event key and same normalized payload are idempotent; conflicting payload is rejected
Dimension/unit and per-stream ordinal are explicit; conversion and sequence allocation remain external
Point uses occurredAt; interval uses start/end with start < end and half-open semantics; partial interval aggregation fails
Raw measurements are immutable; staged forward-ordinal same-stream replacements contribute only through committed correction links
Each original has one terminal correction; competing correction/retraction admits one winner; forward ordinals prevent cycles
Aggregation fails closed on unreadable events/corrections, uses exact minor units and provides a reproducible contributing-ID manifest
Live aggregation is bounded and not a transactional snapshot; authoritative billing requires a separate closure protocol

acceptance.description: fixtures for LLM tokens, compute time and machine hours
